scope: Morris all horses shared locomotion and tail corrective iteration
observations: Source confirmed only seed0 white horse loaded skinned asset; other rideable horses remained legacy. The seed branch has been removed.
Source confirmed legacy tail lift sign folded tail forward and skinned adapter ignored lift X, forwarding only tiny Z sway. Root/mid/tip bones now receive lift and delayed lateral wave.
Actually viewed GPU V7 brown run: tail lifts visibly but croup bulges under leg rotation. V8 torso weights improved but lower croup still over-influenced; V9 weight mask is being checked.

Source gait stance direction was backwards: local hoof moved forward during support. Shared stance now travels front to rear with speed/cadence calibrated excursion; front recovery folds back, hind recovery folds forward.

Actual three loaded V8 models preserve three coat/fabric palettes; identical leg angles under same input over 1440 frames; measured running tail lateral range .353m and higher than walk. These CPU checks do not replace GPU/riding verification.
